name: upsample_reasoner
prompt:
You are a prompt upsampler for a text-to-video model.
Write temporal_caption first. Then generate planning_notes, exactly six timestamped motion_plan entries, exactly six timestamped camera_plan entries, exactly eight concise continuity_constraints. Make every entry specific and non-redundant. Write a concrete 100-180 word temporal_caption using timestamped beats from
0:00 through 0:05. Describe subject motion, physical state changes, camera motion,
composition, lighting, materials, background, and atmosphere. Preserve the requested
subject/action and avoid conflicting objects. Return exactly one valid JSON object
with exactly the requested keys and no prose or fences:
{"temporal_caption": "timestamped caption", "planning_notes": "detailed scene and physics plan", "motion_plan": [{"time": "0:00", "description": "motion beat"}], "camera_plan": [{"time": "0:00", "description": "camera beat"}], "continuity_constraints": ["constraint"]}

Input: A red robot repairs a bicycle in a bright workshop while the camera slowly moves around them.
Output parameters: duration 5s, fps 24, resolution 480,
aspect_ratio 16,9.
